findings.summary: Spec §2.1 (三方验收逐字相等) is unsatisfiable by any real single, so the self-APPROVE path can never fire. EngineSelfGateFacts._receipt_commands extracts the acceptance-stage receipt's `command` via `str(entry['command'])` — the Python repr of an argv list (e.g. "['bash', '-lc', 'uv sync …']" ) — while _acceptance_verbatim compares it against record.json `acceptance_commands`, which DdControlPlane.get() returns as a list of argv lists (derive_acceptance_commands / dd_scripts AcceptanceStage both store `command` as a list, confirmed by audit._frozen_argvs). A list-of-argv-lists can never equal a list-of-repr-strings, so acceptance_argv_verbatim returns ok:False for every production single, assess_evidence always carries a violation, and decide() always returns REJECT. The central deliverable (线自判路径成引擎默认 / positive self-APPROVE) is unreachable — the same 'mechanically REJECTs every dd single' defect the prior rc-ecf0fef2 blocker named. The suite misses it because test_full_positive_measurements_gather_six_ok and the FakeControl test inject verification_commands as a single flat argv and bypass the git-show receipt path, so no test exercises the real list-of-argv-lists record shape against the `.dd-evidence/acceptance.json` receipt.
